fact: KNBS publishes the second Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS II) for 2023/24-2027/28 for download as the national statistical system strategy; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The first Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics (KSDS I) was developed and implemented for 2019/20-2022/23, a period that has ended; KSDS II followed it.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): KSDS 2023-2028.
